tracks.title: Would You Go All The Way?
Rudy Wants To Buy Yez A Drink

verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1970 (US).

physical: Pressed by CBS Pressing Plant, Aston Clinton

notes.text:
Original labels with RSLP 2030 only (no Kinney cat. no)
'Red' Cover:
Gatefold unlaminated, with Bizarre logo & square-box Reprise logo.  No Kinney reference.
Back cover credits include: 
"All the vocals on this album are a preview of the story from 200 Motels. Coming soon."

Recorded at:
The Record Plant (Hollywood)
Trident Studios (London)
T.T.G. Inc. (Hollywood)
Whitney Studios (Glendale)

"The Nancy & Mary Music" recorded live at The Tyrone Guthrie Theater, Minneapolis, Minnesota.

Warner Bros. Records Ltd
Printed in England by MacNeill Press, London S.E.1.

This was the first appearance of Kaylan & Volman on a Zappa album (aka 'Flo & Eddie'). The duo are credited as 'The Phlorescent Leech & Eddie'.
